expectations.evidence: **Status: BLOCKED — the memo was not provided.** No document, file path, or pasted text accompanied the request, so there is nothing to read and nothing I will critique from assumption. / "Please attach or paste the memo, or give me its path (and commit, if it is version-controlled)."

"Findings will be graded: - **FATAL** — unsafe, non-compliant, or unsupported; must fix before use. - **MAJOR** — likely wrong or a real gap; fix before finalizing. - **MINOR** — clarity, consistency, polish." / "The output will include a prioritized revision plan, strengths tied to specific evidence, and confirmation that I have not predicted approval or substituted vague praise for a finding."
